name_input: ACCORD SOFTWARE AND SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED; Accord Software and Systems Private Limited; ACCORD SOFTWARE AND SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED; ACCORD SOFTWARE AND SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug accord-software-and-systems-private-limited) header: "Total Shipments 407 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-26". Export rows actually seen (5 of 407 shown in free view): 2026-02-26 — BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India → TAIPEI, TAIWAN, "12.2 MM X 16MM L1 BAND GNSS MODULE (ITEM SENDING FOR TESTING ON NON RETURNABLE BASIS)", HS 85299090, BOL 1035518; 2026-02-23 — BANGALORE ACC INBLR4 → STUTTGART, GERMANY, "L1+L5 POSITIONING EVALUATION KIT P/NO NAVIKA-1400P GNSS EVALUATION KIT (ITEM SENDING FOR SAMPLE ON NON RETURNABLE BASIS)", HS 85423100, BOL 9915568; 2026-02-10 — BANGALORE ACC INBLR4 → TAURAMENA, DENMARK, "AST-GNSSRF-1/ACCORD GNSS RF FRONT-END INTEGRATED CIRCUIT (IC)", HS 85423100, BOL 9540968; 2026-02-09 — same lane, HS 85423100, BOL 9495229. Counter: page claims 407 total shipments; 5 rows actually visible in free view (all dated Feb 2026, all outbound from Bangalore). Note: the visible export rows are sample/testing/RMA consignments on a non-returnable basis, not commercial volume sales; the 407 figure mixes imports and exports and could not be split in the free view.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) during this run. ImportKey shows only customs records, no domestic supply data. Domestic supply therefore not verified — null, not inferred.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data (address on record: NO.37, KRISHNAREDDY COLONY, DOMLUR LAYOUT, Bangalore). Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code, but the visible consignments are GNSS module/IC samples, evaluation kits and RMA returns to Taiwan, Germany and Denmark — evidence of real cross-border movement, not of commercial export volume. Declared HS 852691 (GNSS radio-navigation apparatus) is broadly consistent with the GNSS modules/ICs seen, though the customs lines themselves carry 85299090 and 85423100; per project rules HS mismatch is not a rejection ground and no correction is asserted here. Counterparty names appearing as buyers (Wavice Inc., KelvinSide Electronics, Aspen Avionics) indicate genuine trade relationships. Domestic supply side is unverified — no GST turnover band, tender or contract evidence obtained, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources).
